cd /workspace && cat > dev/test_perf_search.py <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
tmpl=(b'\xaa'*8).hex(); kinds='KKKDZQTK'
def hdr(k,ttl):
    h=bytearray(b'\xaa'*8); h[3]=0x77; h[5]=3; h[6]=ttl; return h.hex()
def gen(rng):
    nn=rng.randint(2,10)
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nn)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.randint(1,4)) for n in nodes)
    nf=22
    flows=[];offers={}
    for i in range(nf):
        k=rng.randint(2,min(6,nn))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl,kinds=kinds))
        cnt=rng.choice([1,2,3,5,7,rng.randint(1,50)])
        offers[fid]=[(dict(header=hdr(k,k+1),count=cnt))] if rng.random()<0.9 else []
    pin=[]
    if rng.random()<0.3: pin=rng.sample([f['id'] for f in flows],rng.randint(1,3))
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=rng.choice([0,1,3]),pinned=pin,offers=offers)
rng=random.Random(31337)
worst=0; tot=0; n=0
t0=time.time()
for trial in range(4000):
    req=gen(rng)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    n+=1; tot+=el
    if el>worst: worst=el; wreq=req
print('trials',n,'total %.2fs'%(time.time()-t0),'worst %.3fs'%worst)
import json
if worst>1: print(json.dumps(wreq)[:500])
PYEOF
